body:
## Why

Google routes a drive by today's road conditions, not the trip's dates. A trip planned months ahead sees the roads that are closed when it's planned. Seasonal road closures are out of scope (functional spec, section 5 and section 6.1), so the app assumes the roads it routes on are the trip's roads. A closure that's over by the trip breaks that.

In the Montana run on the live site (#273), planned on 2026-11-05 for September 13 to 18, 2027, Google treated Yellowstone's inner roads and Going-to-the-Sun Road as closed for winter:

- **Drive times were false.** It routed around the park. Day 2, Gardiner to Old Faithful by way of Lamar Valley, showed 8½ to 14½ hours of driving, where the coordinator put the real September drive at 3½ to 4 hours. Day 3 showed about 8 hours, against about 2½. The schedule had Lamar Valley at 10:54 a.m. instead of dawn, and dinners after 10 p.m. The driving and opening-hours checks flagged these days all through the session.
- **A must-see couldn't be added.** `select_user_place` for Logan Pass was refused 3 times, with "Google found no driving route ... through Logan Pass Visitor Center". `compute_route` was refused twice when the coordinator first sketched routes through Lamar Valley and Logan Pass. The trip ended with Logan Pass as a stop with no place, and so no time in the schedule.

The coordinator handled it well. It told the user each time, gave its own September times, and saved a trip memory item to check again in spring 2027. But a real user sees a schedule that's wrong on two of six days, with warnings it says to ignore. The evaluations also score turns whose times are wrong.

The traces are in the `road-trip-agent` Phoenix project, on the `claude-code-sonnet` turns of 2026-11-05 from 01:29 to 01:46 UTC. The refusals are at 01:30:01, 01:30:12, 01:31:37, 01:45:36, and 01:45:39.

## Design

- [Functional spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/functional-spec.md), section 5 (out of scope: seasonal road and pass closures) and section 6.1 (checks).
- `src/google/routes-client.ts`, `requestFor`: the request sends no departure time, and is `TRAFFIC_UNAWARE`.

## Open questions

- Is this worth fixing, or is it a known limit of the out-of-scope line, to leave as it is?
- If it's worth fixing, which way? For example: find out whether a Google request option routes on the trip's date. Or let the agent set a stop's place and drive time by hand when Google finds no route. Or add a line to the coordinator's prompt so it plans around a closure that will be over, the way it did here.

## Do

- Find out whether Google Routes can route by a future date's road conditions, and say what it found.
- Then settle the open questions with Joe.

## Done when

- The open questions are settled, and the fix, if any, is in a PR.

## Ends in

A decision, or a PR.

**Settled in:** chat.
